note: Licence: CC BY (page statement; Crossref lists CC BY 4.0). Read on the Frontiers PDF through WebFetch, which returned this Discussion sentence intact; the degree sign is printed as an artefact (◦C) in the PDF text. The sentence says 'the mite' and is in a paper whose study species is T. mercedesae (the Results sentences that report the gradient assay were returned only as longer-than-limit text, so the 32-40 C range is carried from this Discussion sentence alone; mites were also reported as randomly positioned without a gradient, not filed). Name check: Tropilaelaps mercedesae is listed as a species of Tropilaelaps (Laelapidae, Mesostigmata) on the Wikipedia genus page; WA DPIRD page gives Laelapidae, Arachnida; no catalogue page stating accepted status was reachable, so the name rests on that and on the paper's own use. Not in gbif-names.tsv.
